$comment: Curated intelligence-index measurements, the reviewed source of truth for scripts/sync-intellect.mts. RULES: (1) values are cited facts — every entry needs a real source and asOf date, never a guess; (2) canonicalVersion is the permanent display scale — it only changes as a deliberate, breaking re-baseline; (3) a model may have one entry per indexVersion (that overlap is what makes it an equating anchor); (4) fitted equating maps are crystallised here by the sync script at first fit and are then reused verbatim — pass --refit to deliberately refit after adding anchors.
